risks.title: Government contract dependency and resilience risks
risks.score_rationale: The company lost virtually all USAID contracts ($576.4 million in fiscal 2025, representing 10.6% of total revenue) following Executive Order 14169 signed in January 2025 and the cancellation of 83% of USAID programs in February 2025. No significant USAID revenue is expected in fiscal 2026.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company handles sensitive data for government contracts and explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks. The Chief Information Officer, with 18+ years of experience, reports directly to the CEO and oversees cybersecurity risk management.

risks.title: Geopolitical and operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Tetra Tech operates in more than 100 countries across seven continents. Geopolitical risks may affect international operations and contract execution in unstable or at-risk areas.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: As a government services provider in the environment and infrastructure sectors, Tetra Tech is subject to strict regulations and complex compliance requirements.

risks.title: Exposure to natural disaster revenue volatility
risks.score_rationale: In fiscal 2025, a significant portion of state/local revenue growth (28.8%) came from disaster response work related to Hurricanes Helene, Milton and Palisades/Eaton fires. This dependence on one-time events creates revenue volatility.

risks.title: Competition in consulting and engineering services
risks.score_rationale: Tetra Tech operates in a competitive market with numerous players in consulting and engineering services. While ranked #1 in several categories by ENR, it must maintain its position against competition.

risks.title: Technology dependency and market evolution
risks.score_rationale: Tetra Tech relies on advanced analytics, AI and machine learning solutions. It must continue investing in technological innovation to remain competitive.

ai_positioning.summary: Tetra Tech highlights the use of AI and machine learning as key elements of its differentiation strategy. The company integrates advanced analytics, AI and machine learning solutions with its consulting and engineering service offerings to enhance its water, environment and sustainable infrastructure solutions.
evidence: We are Leading with Science throughout our operations, with domain experts across multiple disciplines supported by our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning and digital technology solutions.
Our ability to provide innovative and first-of-kind solutions is enhanced by partnerships with our forward-thinking clients.
